client_tap_id.description: Made by the station, and unique per station forever

status.description: accepted, cooldown, no_game or duplicate from ours. Another team's statuses pass to the station unchanged

lines.description: What the station's game has the station show, one row each. The GeekyKey Service passes them, and complete, to the station with accepted and cooldown only

items.description: One row of the station's 16x2 screen

complete.description: True on the tap that finishes the station's game, such as the passport's last stamp, so the station plays its own tune

seconds.description: Seconds to count down, from when the answer was made

items.description: One row of the station's 16x2 screen, where {s} is the seconds left

lines.description: What the station shows while it counts. {s} may appear once across them

items.description: One row of the station's 16x2 screen

ending.description: What the station shows once the count reaches zero

countdown.description: A screen that counts down, shown in place of lines by a station that knows it. The GeekyKey Service passes it to the station with accepted and cooldown only

title: The answer to the hand-off: POST /geekykey/v1/taps
description: Also: one result per tap in the request, in the same order, with the same client_tap_ids, and {s} at most once across a countdown's lines.
